title: Add release team `open_planning`
author: sea-bass
body:
* Name of the new release team: `open_planning`
* Release repositories to add:
  <!--
  Before release repositories are created, repositories and packages should be submitted to the official rosdistro repository https://github.com/ros/rosdistro for naming review.
  The ros/rosdistro source entry link must be included for each repository.
  Guidelines for package naming are describe in REP-144: https://www.ros.org/reps/rep-0144.html

  If there are any existing release repositories which should have their contents imported into the ros2-gbp organization, list and link to them here.
  Leave the checkbox _unchecked_. The ros2-gbp administrator will check the box when they have completed the repository import.
  -->
  * [`toppra`](https://github.com/hungpham2511/toppra)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/2802107d929fba0e6e11e27ce4f9c9a5d8337126/rolling/distribution.yaml#L9861)
    * Currently adding ourselves as maintainers (see [this issue](https://github.com/hungpham2511/toppra/issues/275) and [this PR](https://github.com/hungpham2511/toppra/pull/277))
  * [`roboplan`](https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/2802107d929fba0e6e11e27ce4f9c9a5d8337126/rolling/distribution.yaml#L7424)
  * [`roboplan_ros`](https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan-ros)
    * [ros/rosdistro source entry](https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/blob/2802107d929fba0e6e11e27ce4f9c9a5d8337126/rolling/distribution.yaml#L7434)

All these sources were added in https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/50441 (for Rolling). Equivalent PRs to Humble, Jazzy, and Kilted also landed.

* Team members
  * [@sea-bass](https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan/blob/4a26ac81e22ced49f37698ce2020209702a4a166/roboplan/package.xml#L7)
  * [@eholum](https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan-ros/blob/0ac5a3784de90a96d003dd5540b6c808dc041e3f/roboplan_ros_cpp/package.xml#L8)
  * [@sjahr](https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan/blob/4a26ac81e22ced49f37698ce2020209702a4a166/roboplan_oink/package.xml#L7)
